findings.claim: FAIL-OPEN against the ruled contract: the PR-level evidence arm discharges a HIGH on ANY non-bot PR-level comment that post-dates the thread root, so a bare GitHub-UI resolve DOES discharge whenever the PR carries any human comment after the finding — no disposition required, nothing naming the thread. The ruling (issue comment 5654663579) says a HIGH resolved THROUGH THE DISPOSITION PATH (a posted disposition naming it, plus the resolve) is discharged and a bare resolve with no disposition on record still applies, fail-closed, otherwise the predicate is one click from vacuous. The implemented rule keys on post-dating alone, reusing resolve-threads deriveEvidence. The ruled negative control passes ONLY because the fixture was built with the extra premise that the sole human PR-level comment PRE-dates the root; that premise is false on real rounds. Verified live: mmnto-ai/liquid-city#1278 returns six User PR-level comments all post-dating every bot root; on the 2871 capture the operator's first PR-level comment is a bare trigger which on a second round necessarily post-dates round-1 roots. The seat discloses the divergence in three places; recorded because the ruling's stated purpose is not achieved in the field.
findings.counterexample: Ran the branch's built core against the negative-control fixture with ONE node appended to pullRequest.comments.nodes: {author:{__typename:'User',login:'satur8d'},createdAt:'2026-09-08T04:00:00Z'} (root 03:00:00Z; the thread carries only the bot's own reply and isResolved:true). Result: allow / ref merge-ready / highInline 0 / dischargedHigh 1, with the discharge notice. Unmodified fixture: deny / high-severity-inline / highInline 1. One human comment of any content flips the ruled negative control. FOLDED (57548351): the PR-level arm requires the review-reply local-lane line on a non-bot comment created strictly after the root; measured on the fourteen calibration rows first (twelve of thirteen deny rows carry it at line start).

findings.claim: FAIL-CLOSED CLAIM FALSIFIED under pilot: `return thread.commentsComplete ? 'none' : 'unread'` routes a bare-resolved HIGH whose thread window is incomplete into the UNEVALUABLE class, which gate-types defines as advisory under pilot. Pre-cure that same input was a predicate-4 FACT and denied at every tier. So the module header's own sentence — a bare resolve with no evidence on record still applies (fail-closed) — and the changeset's equivalent are false for this shape: on the PILOT install it stops blocking. Reachable input: a CodeRabbit/Greptile thread with more than ten comments, none of comments[1..9] non-bot, and no human PR-level comment after the root.
findings.counterexample: Same harness: negative-control fixture with reviewThreads.nodes[0].comments.pageInfo.hasNextPage flipped to true and the non-bot PR-level comment removed. tier=strict -> deny ref unevaluable; tier=pilot -> warn ref unevaluable, highInline 0. Pre-cure (main) the same PR is deny ref high-severity-inline at BOTH tiers. FOLDED (57548351): the unread arm is removed; the shape is a fact-side deny at both tiers whose reason names the window; evidence found inside an incomplete window still discharges (new fixture).

The underlying inference survives by a DIFFERENT witness — firstFailure reaches predicate 5 only after predicates 1-4 return nothing — but the acceptance record must say that for 1279. The counts check out: baseline 13 rows deny with highInline 1/1/1/1/1/5/5/4/1/2/1/2/5 (sum 30), cured the same 13 at highInline 0 with dischargedHigh identical, 1330 stays 0/0.

The observation about the four captures is true; the generalisation is false — merged mmnto-ai/liquid-city#1279 answers DIRTY.

The capture carries SEVEN review threads; SIX are isResolved:false, isOutdated:true and only one (the CodeRabbit Major) is resolved. findings.claim: The new bare-resolve clause never reaches provenance.matched: firstFailure appends the ~170-character clause AFTER the already-bounded quoted body, and the call site re-bounds the whole string to 160, so the distinguishing clause is truncated away in every realistic case.
findings.counterexample: Built gate on the negative control: reason ends with the clause while provenance.matched is exactly 160 chars and ends inside the quoted body. FOLDED (57548351): the clause precedes the quoted body; tests assert it on matched.

findings.claim: An invariant the spec lists is not locked by any test: a candidate whose evidence is found inside the window is discharged even when the window is incomplete. Every discharge fixture carries hasNextPage:false and the only incomplete-window fixture carries no evidence; a mutant moving the completeness test ahead of the evidence tests passes all 82 tests.
findings.counterexample: Scan of all fixtures: {hasNextPage:true} ∩ {evidence present} is EMPTY. FOLDED (57548351): synthetic-high-inline-discharged-window-incomplete.json and its test.

verdict: Leg 1 on the predicate-4 discharge (9380a041, mmnto-ai/totem#2861): 1 BLOCKING (f1 — post-dating alone let any later human comment discharge a bare resolve; counterexample executed on the built core), 2 MATERIAL (f2 — the unread arm downgraded a fact-side deny to pilot warn; f3 — the UNKNOWN-for-every-merged-PR replay claim false for lc#1279), 10 MINOR. Twelve folded in 57548351: the PR-level arm reads the review-reply local-lane line, the unread arm removed, the replay witness restated by the arm reached, the README and docstrings corrected, provenance names the arm, the in-thread test made temporal. f13 (a null-author PR-level comment as evidence) narrowed by the marker and left as a question. Convergence NOT named by this leg: it enumerated the fail-open surface and asked for a re-arm on the fold.
